one_liner: Developers can launch a public connection today for immediate use, with an optional 5-10 business day review for Marketplace listing.

start_today.summary: Developers can create and use a public connection immediately without listing it on the Notion Marketplace.
limits_before_approval: Rate limits apply, approximately 3 requests per second per connection when querying a data source, with overages resulting in throttling, not fees.

composio.note: Composio provides a managed OAuth app for Notion, allowing developers to launch immediately. A custom app is only needed for branding, extra scopes, dedicated rate limits, faster trigger polling, or self-hosted instances.

prerequisites.detail: Required to register OAuth apps (public connections).
Required to create 'internal connections' for team-owned workspace automations.

prerequisites.item: Company name, Website, Privacy Policy link, Terms of Service link
prerequisites.detail: Required for public integrations and displayed on the consent screen.

steps.text: Navigate to the Notion Developer portal.
Set the 'Installation scope' to 'Any workspace' if Marketplace listing is desired.
Provide a Company name, Website, Privacy Policy link, and Terms of Service link for the consent screen.
Define API capabilities, including options for content access (read, update, insert) and user information access (with or without email addresses).
Implement the OAuth 2.0 protocol for user authentication and authorization.
Test the public connection with Notion workspaces.
Submit the public connection for a Notion security review.
Provide integration details including name, description, category, logo, and screenshots for the Marketplace listing.
Wait for the manual review process to complete.

scopes.purpose: Access content within a Notion workspace.
Modify content within a Notion workspace.
Add new content to a Notion workspace.

approval.trigger: Submission of a public connection for listing on the Notion Marketplace.
reviewers_check: Security review of the public connection.
common_rejections: Technical aspects of the integration or listing.

blockers.blocker: Public connections must undergo a Notion security review before being listed on the Marketplace.
blockers.fix: Submit the integration for review and address any feedback.

you_must: Navigate to the Developer portal and create the public connection.

agent.discovery_notes: Notion supports both internal connection API tokens and OAuth 2.0 for public integrations. Public integrations must be set to 'Public' in the developer portal. The Notion OAuth API does not provide refresh tokens, as access tokens do not expire.
